enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in her own room with the door closed and quiet hours respected for rest and recovery
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed with eyes closed. Pulls the blanket up over her shoulders. Turns onto her left side. Adjusts the pillow under her head. Keeps the bedroom door closed. Does not turn on the light. Turns onto her back. Stretches her legs under the blanket. Turns onto her right side. Pulls the blanket back over her feet. Keeps the space heater switched off. Breathes steadily with her eyes closed. Does not leave the bed. Does not walk in the hallway. Makes no sound above quiet hours level. Remains in Bedroom 2 until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking slowly, sitting up in bed and saying her morning prayers before starting the day
enriched_activities.desc: Opens her eyes. Reaches out her right hand to the phone on the bedside table. Presses the phone screen to stop the alarm. Puts the phone back down. Pushes the blanket off with both hands. Places both feet on the floor. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Straightens her back. Presses both palms together in front of her chest. Moves her lips to say morning prayers. Lowers her hands. Stands up from the bed. Picks up her dressing gown from the chair and puts it on. Turns on the bedroom light. Walks to the door. Opens the bedroom door and steps out into the hallway.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing her face, brushing her teeth and getting dressed for her early cafe opening shift (Bathroom is free after Member 1 finishes at 06:10)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Bathroom. Closes the door behind her. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the cold tap. Bends over the basin and splashes water on her face. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel from the rail and wipes her face. Hangs the towel back on the rail. Picks up the toothbrush from the cup. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes her teeth. Spits into the basin. Turns on the tap and rinses her mouth. Turns off the tap. Puts the toothbrush back in the cup. Picks up the cafe uniform from the hook and puts on the shirt and trousers. Pulls on her socks and shoes. Picks up her bag from the floor. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the door and walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a quick breakfast together with Member 1 before he leaves, with a strong cup of tea from her labelled tea shelf
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Says "Good morning" to Member 1 at the counter. Opens the cupboard and takes out the oat container from her labelled shelf. Pours oats into a bowl. Opens the Refrigerator and takes out the milk. Pours milk over the oats. Puts the milk back and closes the Refrigerator door. Picks up the Kettle and fills it with water from the tap. Places the Kettle on its base and presses the switch down. Opens the shelf and takes a tea bag from her labelled tea shelf. Drops the tea bag into a mug. Pours the boiled water into the mug. Picks up a spoon and stirs the tea. Sits down at the kitchen table opposite Member 1. Eats the oats with the spoon. Picks up the mug and drinks the tea. Says "See you tonight" to Member 1. Stands up, picks up her bowl and mug and carries them to the sink. Rinses the bowl and mug under the tap. Places them in the drying rack. Picks up her bag and the EV key from the counter. Walks to the front door. Opens the door and steps out.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV to the cafe for the early opening shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the driveway. Presses the key fob to unlock the EV. Opens the driver door. Sits down in the driver seat. Pulls the door closed. Fastens the seat belt. Presses the start button. Places both hands on the steering wheel. Presses the indicator lever. Steers the EV out of the driveway onto the street. Presses the accelerator. Drives along the road. Stops at the traffic lights and waits. Presses the accelerator again when the light turns green. Steers the EV into the cafe parking bay. Presses the parking brake. Presses the stop button. Unfastens the seat belt. Opens the driver door and steps out. Presses the key fob to lock the EV. Walks to the cafe entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working her barista shift: opening the cafe, pulling espresso, serving customers and packing up leftover food to take home (EV parked at the cafe)
enriched_activities.desc: Unlocks the cafe front door with her key. Pushes the door open. Turns on the front-of-house lights. Walks behind the counter. Presses the switch to start the espresso machine and waits for it to heat. Grinds coffee beans into the portafilter. Tamps the grounds with the tamper. Locks the portafilter into the group head. Presses the brew button. Watches the espresso pour into the cup. Wipes the steam wand with a cloth. Steams milk in the jug. Pours the milk into the cup. Places the cup on the counter. Calls the order number to the customer. Presses the register screen to take payment. Hands the change and receipt to the customer. Wipes down the counter with a cloth. Rinses the milk jugs in the sink. Washes the cups in the sink and stacks them on the rack. Restocks the takeaway cup lids from the storage box. Refills the bean hopper from the bag. Sweeps the floor behind the counter. Lifts the unsold food trays from the display and tips the contents into takeaway containers. Closes the lids and places the containers in her bag. Wipes the display cabinet glass. Presses the switch to turn off the espresso machine. Turns off the front-of-house lights. Picks up her bag. Opens the door and walks out. Locks the cafe door with her key.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV to the Monash University campus and eating a quick self-prepared lunch before class
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the EV parked in the cafe bay. Presses the key fob to unlock it. Opens the driver door and sits down. Pulls the door closed. Fastens the seat belt. Presses the start button. Steers the EV out of the bay onto the road. Drives towards the campus. Stops at the campus car park entrance. Presses the accelerator and steers into a parking space. Presses the parking brake. Presses the stop button. Unfastens the seat belt. Opens the driver door and steps out holding her bag. Presses the key fob to lock the EV. Walks to a bench on campus. Sits down. Opens her bag and takes out the lunch container. Opens the lid. Picks up the fork and eats the lunch. Closes the container lid. Puts the container back in her bag. Stands up. Walks towards the design studio building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending design studio class at Monash University, working on critique and project development
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the studio room. Sits down at a desk. Opens her bag and takes out the laptop. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Types her login password on the keyboard. Opens the design project file. Picks up the sketchbook from the bag and lays it on the desk. Picks up a pencil and draws layout sketches on the page. Stands up and pins her printed sheets on the studio wall. Walks back to the desk and sits down. Listens to the tutor and nods. Answers the tutor's question about the layout. Turns the laptop to show her screen to the classmate seated beside her. Says "I'll change the type size". Types notes into a document on the laptop. Picks up the pencil and makes changes on the sketch. Presses Ctrl+S to save the file. Closes the design file. Presses the shutdown option. Closes the laptop lid. Puts the laptop and sketchbook into her bag. Stands up and pushes the chair under the desk. Walks out of the studio room.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV back home from campus, carrying the cafe leftovers she plans to share
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the campus car park. Presses the key fob to unlock the EV. Opens the driver door and sits down. Places her bag with the leftover food containers on the passenger seat. Pulls the door closed. Fastens the seat belt. Presses the start button. Steers the EV out of the parking space. Drives out of the campus onto the main road. Stops at the intersection and waits for the traffic light. Presses the accelerator when the light turns green. Drives along the street towards home. Steers the EV into the driveway. Presses the parking brake. Presses the stop button. Unfastens the seat belt. Opens the driver door and steps out. Picks up her bag from the passenger seat. Presses the key fob to lock the EV. Walks to the front door. Opens the front door and steps inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking her own dinner in a cleared, clearly labelled section of the kitchen while sipping tea (shared kitchen, coordinating space with other residents cooking around 18:00)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen carrying her bag. Places the bag on her labelled shelf section. Turns on the kitchen light. Washes her hands at the sink. Opens the Refrigerator and takes out the vegetables and the protein pack from her labelled section. Places them on her labelled bench space. Picks up the knife from the drawer. Cuts the vegetables on the chopping board. Picks up the pan and places it on the InductionCooker. Presses the InductionCooker power button. Pours oil into the pan. Tips the chopped vegetables into the pan. Picks up the spatula and stirs the vegetables. Steps aside as Member 3 finishes cooking at 17:30. Picks up the Kettle and fills it with water. Presses the Kettle switch down. Pours the boiled water into a mug over a tea bag. Picks up the mug and sips the tea. Picks up the spatula and stirs the pan again. Adds the protein into the pan. Presses the RangeHood switch on. Picks up the pan lid and covers the pan. Turns off the InductionCooker. Lifts the pan off the cooker and sets it on the trivet. Steps aside from the bench as Member 6 starts batch cooking at 18:00.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating her dinner and putting the shared cafe leftovers in the labelled fridge container, overlapping with the household dinner period
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up a plate from the cupboard. Tips the food from the pan onto the plate with the spatula. Carries the plate to the kitchen table. Pulls out the chair and sits down. Picks up the fork and eats the dinner. Picks up the mug and drinks the tea. Says "How was your shift?" to Member 3 at the table. Picks up her bag and takes out the cafe leftover containers. Opens the lids. Tips the leftover food into the labelled fridge container. Closes the container lid. Opens the Refrigerator door. Places the container into her labelled fridge section. Closes the Refrigerator door. Picks up the plate and cutlery from the table. Carries them to the sink. Scrapes the food scraps into the bin. Rinses the plate under the tap. Places the plate in the dishwasher rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up her pans, wiping her bench space and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walks back to the sink. Picks up the pan from the trivet. Turns on the hot tap. Holds the pan under the water and scrubs it with the sponge. Squeezes dish soap onto the sponge. Rinses the pan under the tap. Turns off the tap. Places the pan on the drying rack. Picks up the spatula and the chopping board and washes them with the sponge. Rinses them and places them on the drying rack. Picks up the cloth from the sink edge. Wipes her labelled bench space. Rinses the cloth and wrings it out. Hangs the cloth back on the rail. Opens the Dishwasher door. Loads the remaining mugs and plates into the rack. Adds a detergent tablet into the dispenser. Closes the Dishwasher door. Presses the start button. Wipes her hands on the towel. Picks up her bag and walks out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and winding down after a long day of work and study (showered earlier to avoid the late-evening Bathroom queue)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Bathroom carrying her towel and clothes. Closes the door behind her. Turns on the bathroom light. Hangs the towel on the hook. Turns on the shower tap. Puts her hand under the water to check the temperature. Turns the tap to adjust it. Steps into the shower. Wets her hair under the water. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Pours shampoo into her palm and rubs it into her hair. Rinses her hair under the water. Picks up the soap and washes her body. Rinses off under the water. Turns off the tap. Steps out of the shower. Picks up the towel and dries her hair and body. Wraps the towel around herself. Puts on her sleep clothes. Picks up the wet towel and hangs it on the rail. Picks up her clothes. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the door and walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on her design deadline at her desk with the desk lamp on, sketching ideas and refining files on her computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Closes the bedroom door. Presses the switch to turn on the DeskLamp. Pulls out the desk chair and sits down. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Types her login password. Opens the design file on the Computer. Picks up the sketchbook from the desk. Picks up the pencil and draws thumbnail sketches on the page. Turns the sketchbook page. Draws more layout sketches. Puts the pencil down. Places both hands on the keyboard and types text into the file. Moves the mouse and clicks to resize the layout frames. Presses the keyboard to change the type font. Presses Ctrl+S to save. Picks up the pencil again and marks notes beside the sketches. Puts the pencil down. Picks up the phone and taps the screen to check the time. Puts the phone back down. Scrolls the mouse wheel through the file. Adjusts the colour swatch panel with the mouse. Presses Ctrl+S again. Closes the design file. Leaves the desk lamp on. Stands up and stretches both arms above her head.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and drinking a last caffeine-free herbal tea before quiet hours begin
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the bedroom door and walks to the Kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Opens the shelf and takes a herbal tea bag from her labelled tea shelf. Drops the tea bag into a mug. Picks up the Kettle and fills it with water from the tap. Places the Kettle on its base and presses the switch down. Waits for the water to boil. Pours the boiled water into the mug. Presses the Kettle switch off. Carries the mug to the kitchen table. Pulls out the chair and sits down. Picks up the mug and drinks the tea in sips. Stands up. Carries the mug to the sink. Rinses the mug under the tap. Places the mug in the drying rack. Turns off the kitchen light. Walks back to Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Saying her evening prayers and reading quietly under the lamp with the space heater on low
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Closes the bedroom door. Presses the switch to turn on the SpaceHeater and sets the dial to low. Pulls out the desk chair and sits down at the desk. Presses both palms together in front of her chest. Moves her lips to say evening prayers. Lowers her hands. Picks up the book from the desk. Opens the book to the bookmark. Turns the book pages and reads. Closes the book. Puts the book back on the desk. Stands up. Picks up her phone and presses the screen to set the alarm. Puts the phone on the bedside table. Pulls back the blanket on the bed. Sits down on the edge of the bed. Turns off the DeskLamp. Lies down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to sleep in her own room with the light off and quiet hours kept around her room
enriched_activities.desc: Lies flat on the bed with the light off. Pulls the blanket up over her shoulders. Turns onto her right side. Adjusts the pillow under her head. Keeps the SpaceHeater running on low. Keeps the bedroom door closed. Closes her eyes. Breathes steadily and remains still. Turns onto her left side. Pulls the blanket over her feet. Does not get up from the bed. Does not turn on any light. Does not make sound above quiet hours level. Remains in Bedroom 2 asleep until the end of the hour.
